programme.title: Witness to Disaster
programme.desc: Behind the scenes of the dramatic action in the Chilean gold and copper mine in San José.On August 5, 2010, a rock burst occurred, trapping thirty-three miners at a depth of 625 meters.They spent 69 days underground before they could be brought to the surface.During this time, they stayed in a chamber with an area of ​​only 50 square meters.Only after a dozen or so days was a hole drilled, enabling not only contact, but also the delivery of food, oxygen and medicines.On October 12, all the men were saved thanks to a special escape capsule.

programme.title: X: The Generation That Changed the World
programme.desc: Often called outsiders, searching for the meaning of their own existence, working from dawn to dusk, although rejecting the rat race and excessive consumerism - generationThe filmmakers will trace all the most important events that influenced the formation of representatives of this generation.Viewers will learn how the development of technology - from the pocket calculator to the birth of Google - social and political upheavals and the emergence of mass culture have changed their everyday lives. When the first Gen Xers were in elementary school, three hundred Americans a week were dying in the Vietnam War.Reports from the front were everyday life for the "Iks" growing up at that time.Like the unrest surrounding the Watergate scandal and the political crisis.It was Generation X who witnessed the resignation of the President of the United States, Richard Nixon, from his position.In this episode we will see interviews with, among others:American politician Gavin Newson, singer Courtney Love and actress Molly Ringwald.
